title: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice Soup
directions: Sauté base — butter + oil + onion 3–4 min.
Add garlic 30–45 sec.
Add chicken + seasonings 3–4 min.
Add rice, coat; add stock; deglaze.
Pressure cook 8 min; natural release 5 min, quick release.
Stir in cream + parmesan + lemon. Add spinach 2–3 min. Adjust.

title: Scottish Lentil Soup with Ham Hough

ingredients.item: Thyme or a few sprigs fresh

directions: Set Instant Pot to Sauté (optional). Soften onion, leek, carrot, and celery in butter/oil for 4–5 minutes.
Add rinsed lentils, parsnip (optional), pepper, thyme, bay leaf, and ham hough.
Pour in 2 L water/stock, ensuring hough is just covered (do not exceed max line).
Lock lid and cook on High Pressure for 45 minutes. Allow natural release for 15–20 minutes.
Remove hough, cool slightly, pull meat from bone, discard fat/skin, and shred.
Stir soup (lentils mostly broken down). Mash or blend briefly if smoother texture desired.
Return shredded ham, adjust salt/pepper. Add splash of malt vinegar or pinch of sugar if needed.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread or oatcakes.
Slow cook alternative: Combine all ingredients (except parsley/salt). Cook 8–9 hours on Low or 5–6 on High. Shred hough, season, and finish as above.
notes: Traditional Scottish red lentil soup with a smoked ham hough. Dual-mode recipe.

title: Carrot, Bacon & Thyme Soup

ingredients.item: Fresh thyme leaves (or ½ tsp dried)
Salt, plus black pepper to taste
Double cream (or 1 tbsp butter) to finish

directions: Crisp bacon: Set Instant Pot to Sauté. Heat olive oil, cook bacon until golden; remove about half for garnish.
Soften base: Add butter, onion, and garlic; cook 2–3 minutes until translucent.
Add carrots & thyme: Stir well and season lightly with salt/pepper.
Add stock: Pour in stock (just over the carrots). Cancel Sauté.
Pressure cook: High Pressure 10 minutes; quick release.
Blend: Purée until smooth (add splash of hot water if too thick).
Finish: Stir in cream or butter, honey, and orange zest. Adjust salt/pepper.
Serve: Ladle into bowls and top with crispy bacon and a sprig of thyme.
notes: Yields ~2 L. For slow cooker: sauté bacon/onion/garlic in a pan, then add all ingredients (except cream/honey/zest) to the slow cooker; cook 4–5 hours on Low (or ~3 hours on High), blend, then finish with cream/honey/zest and season to taste.
